mapper.insert: insert into forum_topic (title, content, user_id, section_id, view_count, reply_count, create_time, update_time, status) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{sectionId}, #{viewCount}, #{replyCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status})
mapper.update:
update forum_topic
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
section_id = #{sectionId},
view_count = #{viewCount},
reply_count = #{replyCount},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where topic_id = #{topicId}
update forum_topic set reply_count = reply_count - 1 where topic_id = #{topicId} and reply_count > 0
